cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Quality Assurance Technician to join our team. The QA Technician is responsible for ensuring product quality and product safety are consistent with corporate objectives. Additional responsibilities include performing raw material receiving testing, in process and finished product testing, document review, formulation, auditing and project work. This position requires a high level of analytical, technical and communication skills.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Assure the compliance of all incoming and outgoing materials, ingredients and packaged products with [Company name masked] standards.
Assist in compliance of all local, state and federal Good Manufacturing Practices, GMP's.
Perform objective and subjective analysis of raw materials and finished goods to comply with [Company name masked] standards.
Maintain accurate quality assurance records, as directed by the Quality Assurance Supervisor and Manager.
Utilize approved lab methods for all samplings required for analysis as outlined in the quality assurance manual.
Notify production management of any out-of-specification incoming materials and/or ingredients prior to unloading of the same.
Attach appropriate identification to product (i.e. Red tag labels).
Assist in the compliance of [Company name masked] policies and procedures.
Constantly look for, suggest, and initiate improved methods to maintain and/or reduce manufacturing costs.
Keep the Quality Assurance Supervisor and Production Manager informed of any production concerns, problems and food safety issues.
Maintain proficiency with daily quality monitoring tasks.
Assist with the preparation of routine (weekly/monthly) and non-routine quality reports.
Participate in training programs as assigned. Some programs require overnight travel.
Remain current on all procedures and procedural changes that are applicable to the position.
Immediately report food safety and food quality issues to the Quality Assurance Supervisor and/or Manager or other members of management with authority to act upon them.
Adhere to all policies, guidelines, and procedures, such as GMP, HACCP, and work and safety rules.
Perform other duties as assigned that will impact and support the overall outcome of the company and department objectives.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High school diploma or equivalent.
Training and/or experience in microbiology.
Experience in a food manufacturing facility working with quality assurance systems.
Ability to manage responsibilities and workflow effectively and efficiently to consistently meet time frames for work assignments.
Effective written and oral communication skills.
Solid decision-making skills with ability to recognize boundaries and seek assistance when needed.
High level of integrity with ability to maintain confidentiality.
Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Self-directed, requiring minimal supervision or guidance.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelors or Associates Degree.
Solid organization skills, project management skills and ability to generate routine and non-routine reports.
Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to effectively work with different groups, departments and levels of management, especially when team actions are necessary.
Experience in deadline driven environment with excellent time management and organization skills.
Self-starter with ability to work both independently and within a team environment.
Demonstrated drive for continuous improvement in quality systems.

Additional responsibilities include performing raw material receiving testing, in process and finished product testing, document review, formulation, auditing and project work. This position requires a high level of analytical, technical and communication skills.
cond_0082.responsibilities: Assure the compliance of all incoming and outgoing materials, ingredients and packaged products with [Company name masked] standards. Assist in compliance of all local, state and federal Good Manufacturing Practices, GMP's. Perform objective and subjective analysis of raw materials and finished goods to comply with [Company name masked] standards. Maintain accurate quality assurance records, as directed by the Quality Assurance Supervisor and Manager. Utilize approved lab methods for all samplings required for analysis as outlined in the quality assurance manual. Notify production management of any out-of-specification incoming materials and/or ingredients prior to unloading of the same. Attach appropriate identification to product (i.e. Red tag labels). Assist in the compliance of [Company name masked] policies and procedures. Constantly look for, suggest, and initiate improved methods to maintain and/or reduce manufacturing costs. Keep the Quality Assurance Supervisor and Production Manager informed of any production concerns, problems and food safety issues. Maintain proficiency with daily quality monitoring tasks. Assist with the preparation of routine (weekly/monthly) and non-routine quality reports. Participate in training programs as assigned. Some programs require overnight travel. Remain current on all procedures and procedural changes that are applicable to the position. Immediately report food safety and food quality issues to the Quality Assurance Supervisor and/or Manager or other members of management with authority to act upon them. Adhere to all policies, guidelines, and procedures, such as GMP, HACCP, and work and safety rules. Perform other duties as assigned that will impact and support the overall outcome of the company and department objectives.
cond_0082.requirements:
Training and/or experience in microbiology.
Experience in a food manufacturing facility working with quality assurance systems.
High energy level with a demonstrated passion for driving continuous improvement in quality systems.
Self-directed, requiring minimal supervision or guidance.
Ability to manage responsibilities and workflow effectively and efficiently to consistently meet time frames for work assignments.
Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to effectively work with different groups, departments and levels of management, especially when team actions are necessary.
Effective written and oral communication skills.
Solid decision-making skills with ability to recognize boundaries and seek assistance when needed.
High level of integrity with ability to maintain confidentiality.
Solid organization skills, project management skills and ability to generate routine and non-routine reports.
Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Self-starter with ability to work both independently and within a team environment.
Experience in deadline driven environment with excellent time management and organization skills.
High school diploma or equivalent.
Bachelors or Associates Degree highly desired.

cond_0121.intro: We are looking for a Quality Assurance Technician to join our team. The QA Technician is responsible for ensuring product quality and product safety are consistent with corporate objectives. Additional responsibilities include performing raw material receiving testing, in process and finished product testing, document review, formulation, auditing and project work. This position requires a high level of analytical, technical and communication skills. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of quality systems and food safety requirements.
cond_0121.responsibilities:
Assure the compliance of all incoming and outgoing materials, ingredients and packaged products with [Company name masked] standards.
Assist in compliance of all local, state and federal Good Manufacturing Practices, GMP's.
Perform objective and subjective analysis of raw materials and finished goods to comply with [Company name masked] standards.
Maintain accurate quality assurance records, as directed by the Quality Assurance Supervisor and Manager.
Utilize approved lab methods for all samplings required for analysis as outlined in the quality assurance manual.
Notify production management of any out-of-specification incoming materials and/or ingredients prior to unloading of the same.
Attach appropriate identification to product (i.e. Red tag labels).
Assist in the compliance of [Company name masked] policies and procedures.
Constantly look for, suggest, and initiate improved methods to maintain and/or reduce manufacturing costs.
Keep the Quality Assurance Supervisor and Production Manager informed of any production concerns, problems and food safety issues.
Maintain proficiency with daily quality monitoring tasks.
Assist with the preparation of routine (weekly/monthly) and non-routine quality reports.
Participate in training programs as assigned. Some programs require overnight travel.
Remain current on all procedures and procedural changes that are applicable to the position.
Immediately report food safety and food quality issues to the Quality Assurance Supervisor and/or Manager or other members of management with authority to act upon them.
Adhere to all policies, guidelines, and procedures, such as GMP, HACCP, and work and safety rules.
Perform other duties as assigned that will impact and support the overall outcome of the company and department objectives.
cond_0121.requirements:
Training and/or experience in microbiology.
Experience in a food manufacturing facility working with quality assurance systems.
High energy level with a demonstrated passion for driving continuous improvement in quality systems.
Self-directed, requiring minimal supervision or guidance.
Ability to manage responsibilities and workflow effectively and efficiently to consistently meet time frames for work assignments.
Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to effectively work with different groups, departments and levels of management, especially when team actions are necessary.
Effective written and oral communication skills.
Solid decision-making skills with ability to recognize boundaries and seek assistance when needed.
High level of integrity with ability to maintain confidentiality.
Solid organization skills, project management skills and ability to generate routine and non-routine reports.
Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Self-starter with ability to work both independently and within a team environment.
Experience in deadline driven environment with excellent time management and organization skills.
High school diploma or equivalent.
Bachelors or Associates Degree highly desired.
cond_0121.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0291.intro: We are looking for a Quality Assurance Technician to join our team.
cond_0291.responsibilities: Assure the compliance of all incoming and outgoing materials, ingredients and packaged products with [Company name masked] standards. Assist in compliance of all local, state and federal Good Manufacturing Practices, GMP's. Perform objective and subjective analysis of raw materials and finished goods to comply with [Company name masked] standards. Maintain accurate quality assurance records, as directed by the Quality Assurance Supervisor and Manager. Utilize approved lab methods for all samplings required for analysis as outlined in the quality assurance manual. Notify production management of any out-of-specification incoming materials and/or ingredients prior to unloading of the same. Attach appropriate identification to product (i.e. Red tag labels). Assist in the compliance of [Company name masked] policies and procedures. Constantly look for, suggest, and initiate improved methods to maintain and/or reduce manufacturing costs. Keep the Quality Assurance Supervisor and Production Manager informed of any production concerns, problems and food safety issues. Maintain proficiency with daily quality monitoring tasks. Assist with the preparation of routine (weekly/monthly) and non-routine quality reports. Participate in training programs as assigned. Some programs require overnight travel. Remain current on all procedures and procedural changes that are applicable to the position. Immediately report food safety and food quality issues to the Quality Assurance Supervisor and/or Manager or other members of management with authority to act upon them. Adhere to all policies, guidelines, and procedures, such as GMP, HACCP, and work and safety rules. Perform other duties as assigned that will impact and support the overall outcome of the company and department objectives.
cond_0291.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High school diploma or equivalent, or equivalent practical experience.
Some training and/or experience in microbiology.
Some background in a food manufacturing facility working with quality assurance systems.
Familiarity with Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Ability to communicate effectively in writing and verbally.
Willingness to work both independently and as part of a team.
Ability to manage responsibilities and workflow to meet deadlines, with openness to developing stronger time management habits.
Solid decision-making skills with willingness to recognize boundaries and seek assistance when needed.
High level of integrity with ability to maintain confidentiality.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's or Associate's Degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience working toward or supporting continuous improvement in quality systems.
Comfort working with minimal supervision in a structured environment.
Experience generating routine and non-routine quality reports.
Familiarity with project management and organization across multiple tasks or departments.

The QA Technician is responsible for ensuring product quality and product safety are consistent with corporate objectives. Additional responsibilities include performing raw material receiving testing, in process and finished product testing, document review, formulation, auditing and project work. This position requires a high level of analytical, technical and communication skills. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of quality systems and food safety requirements.
cond_0418.responsibilities:
Assure the compliance of all incoming and outgoing materials, ingredients and packaged products with [Company name masked] standards.
Assist in compliance of all local, state and federal Good Manufacturing Practices, GMP's.
Perform objective and subjective analysis of raw materials and finished goods to comply with [Company name masked] standards.
Maintain accurate quality assurance records, as directed by the Quality Assurance Supervisor and Manager.
Utilize approved lab methods for all samplings required for analysis as outlined in the quality assurance manual.
Notify production management of any out-of-specification incoming materials and/or ingredients prior to unloading of the same.
Attach appropriate identification to product (i.e. Red tag labels).
Assist in the compliance of [Company name masked] policies and procedures.
Constantly look for, suggest, and initiate improved methods to maintain and/or reduce manufacturing costs.
Keep the Quality Assurance Supervisor and Production Manager informed of any production concerns, problems and food safety issues.
Maintain proficiency with daily quality monitoring tasks.
Assist with the preparation of routine (weekly/monthly) and non-routine quality reports.
Participate in training programs as assigned. Some programs require overnight travel.
Remain current on all procedures and procedural changes that are applicable to the position.
Immediately report food safety and food quality issues to the Quality Assurance Supervisor and/or Manager or other members of management with authority to act upon them.
Adhere to all policies, guidelines, and procedures, such as GMP, HACCP, and work and safety rules.
Perform other duties as assigned that will impact and support the overall outcome of the company and department objectives.
cond_0418.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High school diploma or equivalent.
Training and/or experience in microbiology.
Experience in a food manufacturing facility working with quality assurance systems.
Ability to manage responsibilities and workflow effectively and efficiently to consistently meet time frames for work assignments.
Effective written and oral communication skills.
Solid decision-making skills with ability to recognize boundaries and seek assistance when needed.
High level of integrity with ability to maintain confidentiality.
Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Self-directed, requiring minimal supervision or guidance.
Experience in a deadline driven environment with excellent time management and organization skills.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's or Associate's Degree.
High energy level with a demonstrated drive for continuous improvement in quality systems.
Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to effectively work with different groups, departments and levels of management, especially when team actions are necessary.
Solid organization skills, project management skills and ability to generate routine and non-routine reports.
Self-starter with ability to work both independently and within a team environment.
cond_0418.values: We value ambition, achievement, and consistent follow-through. We believe strong outcomes come from maintaining high expectations for the work we do.

cond_0467.intro: We are looking for a Quality Assurance Technician to join our team. This includes driving raw material receiving testing, in-process and finished product testing, document review, formulation, auditing, and project work. This position requires a high level of analytical, technical, and communication skills.
cond_0467.responsibilities:
Assure the compliance of all incoming and outgoing materials, ingredients, and packaged products with [Company name masked] standards.
Direct compliance with all local, state, and federal Good Manufacturing Practices, GMP's.
Execute objective and subjective analysis of raw materials and finished goods to comply with [Company name masked] standards.
Maintain accurate quality assurance records, as directed by the Quality Assurance Supervisor and Manager.
Utilize approved lab methods for all samplings required for analysis as outlined in the quality assurance manual.
Notify production management of any out-of-specification incoming materials and/or ingredients prior to unloading of the same.
Attach appropriate identification to product (i.e. Red tag labels).
Ensure compliance with [Company name masked] policies and procedures.
Proactively identify and initiate improved methods to maintain and/or reduce manufacturing costs.
Keep the Quality Assurance Supervisor and Production Manager informed of any production concerns, problems, and food safety issues.

Remain current on all procedures and procedural changes that are applicable to the position.

Perform other duties as assigned that will impact and support the overall outcome of the company and department objectives.

cond_0565.intro: We are looking for a Quality Assurance Technician to join our team. cond_0565.responsibilities:
Assure the compliance of all incoming and outgoing materials, ingredients and packaged products with [Company name masked] standards.
Support compliance with all local, state and federal Good Manufacturing Practices, GMP's.
Perform objective and subjective analysis of raw materials and finished goods to comply with [Company name masked] standards.
Maintain accurate quality assurance records, as directed by the Quality Assurance Supervisor and Manager.
Utilize approved lab methods for all samplings required for analysis as outlined in the quality assurance manual.
Notify production management of any out-of-specification incoming materials and/or ingredients prior to unloading of the same.
Attach appropriate identification to product (i.e. Red tag labels).
Support compliance with [Company name masked] policies and procedures.
Identify and suggest improved methods to maintain and/or reduce manufacturing costs.
Keep the Quality Assurance Supervisor and Production Manager informed of production concerns, problems and food safety issues.
Maintain proficiency with daily quality monitoring tasks.
Assist with the preparation of routine (weekly/monthly) and non-routine quality reports.

Remain current on all procedures and procedural changes that are applicable to the position.
Report food safety and food quality issues promptly to the Quality Assurance Supervisor and/or Manager or other members of management with authority to act upon them.
